records.name: Mental Health Hotline 1323
records.what: The Department of Mental Health (Ministry of Public Health) runs this free, confidential hotline 24 hours a day, every day, for stress, anxiety, sadness, loss and crisis. Counselling psychologists answer.
records.who: Anyone in Thailand. Help is given in Thai.
records.start: Call 1323 at any time. You can also book a call-back on the 1323 website.
